name: Koryō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Koryō town emblem in black: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised letter M.
history: Flag of the former town of Koryō in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1969.

features.role: Koryō town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised letter M
